subject: Beamos
text: Target Beamos statues and throw a bomb at them to destroy them.

evidence.quote: The Beamos statues are annoying enemies that shoot lazer beams at you incessantly. Target them and throw a bomb at them to destroy them.

subject: King Dodongo
text: When King Dodongo starts breathing in with an open mouth, throw a bomb into its throat to stun it, slash it with your sword, and then sidestep or hide in a corner while it rolls.

evidence.quote: When it starts to breath in and open its mouth, quickly throw a bomb into its throat. Then, while it's stunned, slice it with your sword. Afterwards, sidestep or hide in a corner while it rolls around the room. Repeat the above process until it dies.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is located behind the Armos Statue.

evidence.quote: Get 3 Skulltula Tokens (#23-#25)...Kill the Gold Skulltula (#1) behind the Armos Statue.

subject: Chest
text: The dungeon map is inside a chest behind a bombed fake wall on the west ledge.

evidence.quote: Bomb the fake wall on this side and get the map from the chest.

subject: Stairs
text: Placing the lone bomb flower in-between the other rows blasts all of them and lowers the stairs.

evidence.quote: Pick up the lone bomb flower and place it in-between the other rows to blast all of them and lower the stairs.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is found on the vines near the top door after climbing the lowered stairs.

evidence.quote: Climb the stairs and go around, shoot the Gold Skulltula (#2) on the vines near the top door, and climb up to get the token.

subject: Chest
text: A chest containing Bombs is reached by shooting two eyes to cross platforms.

evidence.quote: Shoot the first eye and jump to the platform, then shoot the second eye in the nitch to the left to get across the other platform; get the Bombs from the chest at the end of the room.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is in the room past the bombed fake wall on the opposite side of the hallway.

evidence.quote: Go across this room, then bomb the fake wall on the opposite side, and get the Gold Skulltula (#3) in the room past that wall.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby inside the fairy fountain past the blown-up boulder at the top of the rock face summons the Great Fairy to grant the Magic Meter.

evidence.quote: Get Magic Meter (Death Mountain)...Climb up the rock face at the end, and blow up the boulder in the rock wall at the top. Enter at that spot to reach a fairy fountain. Play Zelda's Lullaby in front of the fountain to make the Great Fairy appear.

subject: Crate
text: Rolling into the first crate upon entering Death Mountain Crater reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Enter the path to the right of the fairy fountain to enter Death Mountain Crater. Quickly roll into the first crate you see to make a Gold Skulltula pop out, kill it and then get back out.

subject: House
text: Riding the owl down from Death Mountain allows you to drop onto the upper deck of a house and enter through a cracked wall to get a Heart Piece.

evidence.quote: Talk to the owl at the top of Death Mountain, and he'll give you a ride down the mountain. From where you land, drop down onto the upper deck of this house and enter through the cracked wall. Get the Heart Piece from inside.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Bombing the boulder at the dead end east of the gates and crawling through leads to a Great Fairy's fountain where you learn Din's Fire.

evidence.quote: Enter the Hyrule Castle area from the Market. Climb up the vines and drop down past the gates, then go all the way east to the 'dead end'. Bomb the boulder here and go through the crawlspace to get to another Great Fairy's fountain. This fairy teaches you this fire-producing spell.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: The 30 Capacity Bomb Bag, Heart Piece #11, and Bombchus are prizes from the Bombchu Game at the Market.

evidence.quote: Get 30 Capacity Bomb Bag (Market)...Get Heart Piece #11 (Market)...Get Bombchus (Market)...These three items are all prizes from the Bombchu Game at the Market, which is now open.

subject: Giant spinning pot
text: Lighting the torches on the bottom floor activates a giant spinning pot, which spits out a Heart Piece when a bomb is thrown into it.

evidence.quote: Light the torches with Din's Fire and a Deku Stick to activate a giant spinning pot. Go up to the next floor and throw a bomb in the pot, and it will spit out a Heart Piece.

subject: Crate
text: Rolling into the crate at the end of the boulder-filled room on the top floor reveals a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote: On the top floor, bomb the boulders blocking your way, then go past them and through the path there. Make your way through this room, bombing the boulders until you reach the end. Roll into the crate here to find a Gold Skulltula.

subject: Rolling Goron
text: Bombing the giant rolling Goron twice rewards you with a bomb capacity upgrade.

evidence.quote: Bomb the giant Goron rolling around one of the floors in the city twice, and he will give you another bomb capacity upgrade.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: A Deku Scrub sells the 30 Capacity Deku Nut upgrade inside a hole under a boulder on the screen below Sacred Forest Meadow.

evidence.quote: - Get 30 Capacity Deku Nut Holder (Lost Woods) ... Now in the woods, go west, west, forward, then west to reach the screen below the Sacred Forest Meadow. Bomb the boulder here and fall through the hole. The Deku Scrub inside sells this upgrade.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: A Deku Scrub in a hole inside the fenced-in area near Lake Hylia sells a Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

evidence.quote: In the middle of the fenced-in area, bomb the ground. Drop in the hole, and the Deku Scrub will sell you this Heart Piece for 10 rupees.

subject: Magic Bean Salesman
text: A man in Zora's River sells Magic Beans at progressively higher prices.

evidence.quote: Go forward and bomb the boulders to continue, then talk to the man farther down. He sells Magic Beans at progressively higher prices.

subject: Ledge
text: Using the chicken near the circle of stones allows you to float across ledges to reach a Heart Piece on a platform.

evidence.quote: Grab the chicken near the circle of stones, hop across to the ledge on the right, go forward and to the left. Jump up around the ledges and use the chicken to float to the ledge just before the Heart Piece. Drop the chicken, then jump to the platform with the Heart Piece.

subject: Ledge
text: Floating down with a chicken to a lower ledge near the end of the river rewards Heart Piece #15.

evidence.quote: - Get Heart Piece #15 (Zora's River) Drop down to the platform below and grab the chicken, then make your way to the end of the river. Use the chicken to float down to the ledge below with the Heart Piece.

subject: Ladder
text: A Gold Skulltula is on a ladder near the waterfall at the end of the river.

evidence.quote: At the end of the river, drop down near the waterfall. There is a Gold Skulltula on a nearby ladder.

subject: Chest
text: Lighting all torches on the spiraling path and behind the waterfall makes a chest with a Heart Piece appear.

evidence.quote: On the spiraling path that leads to King Zora are many torches, including two behind the waterfall on the bottom floor. Light all of them to make a chest appear with the Heart Piece.

subject: Diving Game
text: Collecting five blue rupees within the time limit in the diving game awards the Silver Scales.

evidence.quote: Dive and get the five blue rupees in the time limit to get the Silver Scales, which enable Link to dive longer.

subject: Underwater
text: Diving below the water near the underwater shortcut from Zora's Domain lets you retrieve a bottle containing a message.

evidence.quote: From the diving game Zora, jump off the cliff again into the water, then swim forward, through an underwater passage, to get to Lake Hylia. Dive to get thebottle sitting nearby below the water...give King Zora the message in a bottle

subject: Tree
text: Rolling into the tree on the platform in the southeast corner of the lake makes a Gold Skulltula fall out.

evidence.quote: Go past Jabu Jabu to the right, and swim to the southeast corner of the lake, onto a platform. Roll into the tree here to make a Gold Skulltula fall out.

subject: Great Fairy
text: Bombing the boulder on the southeast platform opens a cave to a fairy fountain that teaches Farore's Wind.

evidence.quote: Bomb the nearby boulder on this platform to open up a huge cave. Go inside to find another fairy fountain; this one teaches you Farore's Wind.

subject: Jabu Jabu
text: Dropping a bottled fish caught in Zora's Domain in front of Jabu Jabu causes him to suck Link inside.

evidence.quote: Catch a fish in one of your bottles from Zora's Domain, then drop the fish in front of Jabu Jabu in Zora's Fountain. The great fish will suck Link into his mouth.

subject: Barinade
text: Detach Barinade from the wall using the Boomerang, slash it with the sword, hit its main body with the Boomerang to kill the surrounding squids, and finish it off with Boomerang and sword strikes.

evidence.quote: First, detach it from the wall with your Boomerang and slash it with your sword. In the next phase, hit the main body with the Boomerang, then kill all the squids around it. Afterwards it will be undefended, and you can finish it off with the Boomerang and sword.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is obtained by shooting the Skulltula and climbing up in the room after falling down the hole with Ruto.

evidence.quote: Get 4 Skulltula Tokens (#30-#33)...In the next room, shoot the Gold Skulltula (#1) and climb up to the token.

subject: Chest
text: Stepping on the switch while carrying Ruto opens the far east door, where defeating enemies awards the Boomerang from a chest.

evidence.quote: Go through the door on the far east here- step on the switch while carrying Ruto to open it- and kill the enemies to get the Boomerang from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A second Gold Skulltula token in the pit room is collected with the Boomerang to the right of the first.

evidence.quote: There is another Gold Skulltula to the right of this one (#3); collect the token with the Boomerang.

subject: Chest
text: Defeating the Armos Statue through the west unlocked door leads to the compass.

evidence.quote: Go through the west unlocked door, then south after that....Kill the Armos Statue and get the compass, then go back north.

subject: Statue head mouth
text: Dropping bombs through gaps on the bridge into both eyes of the statue opens the statue head's mouth.

evidence.quote: Go to the next room and hit the switch, then step onto the bridge and drop...down bombs through both gaps, into the eyes of the statue below....Drop down and enter the statue head's mouth to the next room.

subject: Chest
text: Placing Ruto on the switch on the west side unlocks a door to a tentacle that yields the map from a chest when killed with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Now go back to the west side of the room and place Ruto on the switch, then...go through the unlocked door....Kill the tentacle with the Boomerang and get the map from the chest.

subject: Chest
text: Killing enemies within the time limit through the first door on the left yields the compass from a chest.

evidence.quote: Go back to the previous room and go through the first door on the left....Kill the enemies in the time limit and get the compass from the chest.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Dropping into the pit previously blocked by a green tentacle leads to a Gold Skulltula token.

evidence.quote: Go south two rooms, then jump into the pit that was previously blocked by a...green tentacle, with Ruto....Shoot the nearby Gold Skulltula here (#2) and collect the token.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula token is located on vines after stunning platforms with the Boomerang.

evidence.quote: Stun the platforms with the Boomerang and jump across to the next room....Shoot the Gold Skulltula (#4) on one of the vines here and climb up to the...token.
